note:
The numbers the leveling planner needs that NO table in the pinned YuanShen dump publishes. Everything else it uses is derived into app/data/yuanshen/snapshot/planner_economy.json. Hand-maintained, which is why it lives outside snapshot/ -- that directory means 'derived from the pinned dump' and these are not.

RULE: an entry with a non-null value MUST carry a non-empty `source` naming where the number came from. tests/unit/test_planner_economy.py enforces it. A null value is not a bug -- the planner reports that source's resin as unknown rather than guessing, which is the same discipline as 'a skipped check is never a pass'.

These are keyed by SOURCE, not by material. Every trounce domain yields its materials the same way, so one number prices all 47 weekly-boss drops rather than 47 hand-typed entries -- and the rate genuinely is a property of the activity, not of the item.

What is NOT here, and why: elemental gems, common enemy drops and local specialties cost no resin at all (owner, 2026-09-07), so they need no rate. Gems in particular drop from a world boss alongside the boss material in the same 40-resin run, so charging for both would bill that run twice. See MaterialSource in app/services/planner/economy.py.

character.comment: Mora charged per point of character EXP fed. Not in any of the 1,935 tables. Set this to the number of EXP points one mora buys.

weapon.comment: Mora charged per point of weapon EXP fed.

weekly_boss.comment: Expected drops of ONE named weekly-boss material per trounce-domain run. A boss carries three materials and drops a random one, so this is the per-material expectation, not the total. `resin` is the current trounce cost and also needs confirming -- DungeonExcelConfigData does not price trounce domains, and the one 60-resin row in InvestigationMonsterConfigData is Andrius.

ley_line_exp.comment: Expected character EXP **points** per Blossom of Revelation run. `resin` is derived -- BlossomChestExcelConfigData publishes 20 for BLOSSOM_REFRESH_EXP -- but the yield is not published anywhere.

ley_line_mora.comment: Expected **mora** per Blossom of Wealth run. `resin` is derived from BlossomChestExcelConfigData (BLOSSOM_REFRESH_SCOIN); the yield is not published.
